contentItem.title: 圆锥体积是同底同高圆柱的三分之一
contentItem.englishTitle: Any cone is a third part of the cylinder which has the same base with it and equal height.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: Any cone is a third part of the cylinder which has the same base with it and equal height.
任何锥体都是圆柱体的第三部分,与圆柱体的高度相同,与底边相同。
For let a cone have the same base, namely the circle ABCD, with a cylinder and equal height; I say that the cone is a third part of the cylinder, that is, that the cylinder is triple of the cone.
锥体的底边,即圆ABCD, 圆柱体和高度相等; 我说锥体是圆锥体的第三个部分, 也就是圆锥体的三倍。
For if the cylinder is not triple of the cone, the cylinder will be either greater than triple or less than triple of the cone.
因为如果圆锥体不是锥体的三倍,圆锥体的三倍或三倍以上。
First let it be greater than triple, and let the square ABCD be inscribed in the circle ABCD; [[IV. 6](/principles/euclid-4-6)] then the square ABCD is greater than the half of the circle ABCD.
首先,应将其增加到三倍以上,然后将正方形 ABCD标在ABCD圆内;然后,正方形 ABCD标在ABCD圆内。 [[IV. 6](/principles/euclid-4-6)]
From the square ABCD let there be set up a prism of equal height with the cylinder.
从正方形、ABCD开始 设置一个与圆柱体相等高度的棱镜

Then the prism so set up is greater than the half of the cylinder, inasmuch as, if we also circumscribe a square about the circle ABCD [[IV. 7](/principles/euclid-4-7)], the square inscribed in the circle ABCD is half of that circumscribed about it, and the solids set up from them are parallelepipedal prisms of equal height, while parallelepipedal solids which are of the same height are to one another as their bases; [[XI. 32](/principles/euclid-11-32)] therefore also the prism set up on the square ABCD is half of the prism set up from the square circumscribed about the circle ABCD; [cf. [XI. 28](/principles/euclid-11-28), or [XII. 6 and 7, Por.](/principles/euclid-12-6)] and the cylinder is less than the prism set up from the square circumscribed about the circle ABCD; therefore the prism set up from the square ABCD and of equal height with the cylinder is greater than the half of the cylinder.

如此建立的棱柱大于圆柱体的一半,因为如果我们同时将圆圈ABCD圈的正方形圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈因此,正方形 ABCD圆圈上的棱镜也是从正方形圆圈上划定的棱镜的一半;或]圆圈上划定的棱镜小于从正方形圆圈上划定的棱镜;因此,从正方形 ABCD圆圈上划定的与圆柱体同等高度的棱镜大于圆柱的一半。   [cf. [[IV. 7](/principles/euclid-4-7)] [[XI. 32](/principles/euclid-11-32)] [XI. 28](/principles/euclid-11-28) [XII. 6 and 7, Por.](/principles/euclid-12-6)

Let the circumferences AB, BC, CD, DA be bisected at the points E, F, G, H, and let AE, EB, BF, FC, CG, GD, DH, HA be joined; then each of the triangles AEB, BFC, CGD, DHA is greater than the half of that segment of the circle ABCD which is about it, as we proved before. [[XII. 2](/principles/euclid-12-2)]
让AB、BC、CD、DA、H点的环形线两分为两部分,E、F、G、H点的环形线连接AE、EB、BF、FC、CG、GD、DH、HA点的环形线;然后,正如我们以前所证明的那样,每个三角形AEB、BFC、CGD、DHA和DHA之间的环形线都大于ABCD圈中与之相关的部分的一半。 [[XII. 2](/principles/euclid-12-2)]

On each of the triangles AEB, BFC, CGD, DHA let prisms be set up of equal height with the cylinder; then each of the prisms so set up is greater than the half part of that segment of the cylinder which is about it, inasmuch as, if we draw through the points E, F, G, H parallels to AB, BC, CD, DA, complete the parallelograms on AB, BC, CD, DA, and set up from them parallelepipedal solids of equal height with the cylinder, the prisms on the triangles AEB, BFC, CGD, DHA are halves of the several solids set up; and the segments of the cylinder are less than the parallelepipedal solids set up; hence also the prisms on the triangles AEB, BFC, CGD, DHA are greater than the half of the segments of the cylinder about them.

在AEB、BFC、CGD、DHA三角形上,设置与圆柱形相等高度的棱镜;如此建立的棱柱均大于圆柱体的半部分,因为如果我们从E、F、G、H点与AB、BC、CD、DA点平行,则在AB、BC、CD、DA点上完成平行四边形点,并从中建立与圆柱体同等高度的平行管道固体,三角体上的棱柱为AEB、BFC、CGD、DHA点是所建若干固体的二分之一;圆柱体的部位低于所设置的平行管道固体;因此,三角形上的棱镜也大于圆柱体上半个部分。

Thus, bisecting the circumferences that are left, joining straight lines, setting up on each of the triangles prisms of equal height with the cylinder, and doing this continually, we shall leave some segments of the cylinder which will be less than the excess by which the cylinder exceeds the triple of the cone. [[X. 1](/principles/euclid-10-1)]
因此,在将左侧环绕、连接直线、在与圆柱体相等高度的三角形棱镜上设置双切线,并且连续这样做时,我们将留下一些圆柱体的分块,这些分块将小于圆锥体超过锥体三倍的过量。 [[X. 1](/principles/euclid-10-1)]

Let such segments be left, and let them be AE, EB, BF, FC, CG, GD, DH, HA; therefore the remainder, the prism of which the polygon AEBFCGDH is the base and the height is the same as that of the cylinder, is greater than triple of the cone.
将这些部分留作AE、EB、BF、FC、CG、GD、DH、HA;因此,其余部分(多边形AEBFGDH是底边,高度与圆锥体相同)大于锥体的三倍。

But the prism of which the polygon AEBFCGDH is the base and the height the same as that of the cylinder is triple of the pyramid of which the polygon AEBFCGDH is the base and the vertex is the same as that of the cone; [[XII. 7, Por.](/principles/euclid-12-7)] therefore also the pyramid of which the polygon AEBFCGDH is the base and the vertex is the same as that of the cone is greater than the cone which has the circle ABCD as base.
但是,多边形ABFGDH是底边的棱镜,与圆柱的高度相同,是金字塔的三倍,多边形ABFGDH是底边的顶部与锥体的一样;因此,多边形ABFGDH是底边的金字塔,而圆锥的顶部则大于ABCD为底边的锥体。 [[XII. 7, Por.](/principles/euclid-12-7)]
But it is also less, for it is enclosed by it: which is impossible.
但它也更少,因为它被它包住:这是不可能的。
Therefore the cylinder is not greater than triple of the cone.
因此,圆柱体不超过锥体的三倍。
I say next that neither is the cylinder less than triple of the cone,
我说接下来的 圆锥体的气瓶 都不到锥体的三倍
For, if possible, let the cylinder be less than triple of the cone, therefore, inversely, the cone is greater than a third part of the cylinder.
如果可能,让圆柱体小于圆锥的三倍,因此,圆锥体则大于圆锥体的三分之一。
Let the square ABCD be inscribed in the circle ABCD; therefore the square ABCD is greater than the half of the circle ABCD.
让正方形 ABCD在ABCD圆内登记,因此正方形 ABCD圆大于ABCD圆的一半。

Now let there be set up from the square ABCD a pyramid having the same vertex with the cone; therefore the pyramid so set up is greater than the half part of the cone, seeing that, as we proved before, if we circumscribe a square about the circle, the square ABCD will be half of the square circumscribed about the circle, and if we set up from the squares parallelepipedal solids of equal height with the cone, which are also called prisms, the solid set up from the square ABCD will be half of that set up from the square circumscribed about the circle; for they are to one another as their bases. [[XI. 32](/principles/euclid-11-32)]

现在,让我们从正方形 ABCD金字塔上 建立起来,一个金字塔 与锥形有着相同的顶端;因此,如此建立的金字塔大于锥形的一半,正如我们以前所证明的那样,如果我们将圆圈的正方形圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈圈 [[XI. 32](/principles/euclid-11-32)]
Hence also the thirds of them are in that ratio; therefore also the pyramid of which the square ABCD is the base is half of the pyramid set up from the square circumscribed about the circle.
因此,其中三分之一也处于这一比;因此,其中正方形 ABCD是金字塔,是正方形所限定的圆形的金字塔的一半。
And the pyramid set up from the square about the circle is greater than the cone, for it encloses it.
圆形的金字塔从正方形开始 大于圆锥,因为它是圆锥的附体。
Therefore the pyramid of which the square ABCD is the base and the vertex is the same with that of the cone is greater than the half of the cone.
因此,金字塔的正方形 ABCD是底边, 和锥体的顶部相同, 大于锥体的一半。

Let the circumferences AB, BC, CD, DA be bisected at the points E, F, G, H, and let AE, EB, BF, FC, CG, GD, DH, HA be joined; therefore also each of the triangles AEB, BFC, CGD, DHA is greater than the half part of that segment of the circle ABCD which is about it.
让环形AB、BC、CD、DA、H两侧相交,E、F、G、H、BC、E、CG、GD、DH、HA相互连接,因此,每个三角形AEB、BFC、CGD、DHA大于该圆形ABCD的半部分。

Now, on each of the triangles AEB, BFC, CGD, DHA let pyramids be set up which have the same vertex as the cone; therefore also each of the pyramids so set up is, in the same manner, greater than the half part of that segment of the cone which is about it.
现在,在每一个三角形上,AEB,BFC,CGD,DHA,让金字塔 建立起来,这些金字塔和锥体有着相同的顶点。 因此,每个金字塔都以同样的方式, 大于锥体的半部分。

Thus, by bisecting the circumferences that are left, joining straight lines, setting up on each of the triangles a pyramid which has the same vertex as the cone, and doing this continually, we shall leave some segments of the cone which will be less than the excess by which the cone exceeds the third part of the cylinder. [[X. 1](/principles/euclid-10-1)]
因此,通过将左侧的环形分两部分,连接直线,在每个三角形上设置一个金字塔,其顶部与锥体相同,并且不断这样做,我们将留下锥体的某些部分,这些部分将少于锥体超过圆柱体第三部分的多余部分。 [[X. 1](/principles/euclid-10-1)]

Let such be left, and let them be the segments on AE, EB, BF, FC, CG, GD, DH, HA; therefore the remainder, the pyramid of which the polygon AEBFCGDH is the base and the vertex the same with that of the cone, is greater than a third part of the cylinder.

任由这些部分留下,并任由它们成为AE、EB、BF、FC、CG、GD、DH、HA段;因此,其余部分,即多边形个阿拉伯-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-非洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲-亚洲

But the pyramid of which the polygon AEBFCGDH is the base and the vertex the same with that of the cone is a third part of the prism of which the polygon AEBFCGDH is the base and the height is the same with that of the cylinder; therefore the prism of which the polygon AEBFCGDH is the base and the height is the same with that of the cylinder is greater than the cylinder of which the circle ABCD is the base.
但金字塔的多边形AEBFGDH是底边,圆锥的顶部与锥形的一样,是棱镜的第三个部分,多边形AEBFGDH是底边,高度与圆柱体的高度相同;因此,多边形AEBFGDH是底边,圆柱体的高度大于ABCD圆圆圆圆圆底边。
But it is also less, for it is enclosed by it: which is impossible.
但它也更少,因为它被它包住:这是不可能的。
Therefore the cylinder is not less than triple of the cone.
因此,圆柱不少于锥体的三倍。
But it was proved that neither is it greater than triple; therefore the cylinder is triple of the cone; hence the cone is a third part of the cylinder.
但事实证明,它既不大于三倍;因此,圆锥体是圆锥体的三倍;因此,圆锥体是圆锥体的三分之一。
Therefore etc. Q. E. D.
因此,等等,证毕。
